name: router-off
description: A two-antenna wireless router interrupted by a diagonal slash.
useCase: Indicate that a named wireless router is disabled or unavailable.
misuse: Use a label to state the affected control and whether it is disabled or unavailable.

16.reason: A complete right antenna, the visible lower left antenna and both LEDs identify the physical router without a wireless activity arc.

24.reason: The broad enclosure, complete right antenna and two separate indicators preserve the router identity around the slash.
